# Benchmark International Middle Market

> Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents privately held companies across the United States with $50M–$500M in total enterprise value (TEV) on strategic sales, mergers, and qualifying change-of-control transactions, across five industries: Industrials, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare, Technology.

Information as of October 2026. Contact: 813-771-6675, mmt@benchmarkintl.com. Parent firm: Benchmark International (https://www.benchmarkintl.com/).

## Industries
- [Industrials](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/industrial.html): Manufacturing, industrial distribution, building products, energy and environmental services, and transportation.
- [Business Services](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/business-services.html): Commercial and facility services, marketing and tech-enabled services, engineering and consulting, financial and insurance services, and staffing and human capital.
- [Consumer](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/consumer.html): Food and beverage (including restaurants), consumer brands and products, foodservice and distribution, and consumer services.
- [Healthcare](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/healthcare.html): Provider services, life sciences and diagnostics, medical products and distribution, and pharmacy and healthcare services.
- [Technology](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/industries/technology.html): Vertical software, enterprise and infrastructure software, IT and managed services, and communications and hardware.

## Industry reports
- [Industrials Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/industrial-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Order books are full, the deal market has become more selective and buyers are paying the most for power, data center, aerospace and service revenue.
- [Business Services Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/business-services-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across commercial, professional and human capital services.
- [Consumer Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/consumer-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Strategic and financial buyers stayed active across the consumer industry through the third quarter, and they are paying for brands and operators that have held price and volume while the cost of financing a purchase rises.
- [Healthcare Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/healthcare-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Mergers and acquisitions across provider services, life sciences, medical products and pharmacy services.
- [Technology Q4 2026 M&A Industry Report](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.html) ([PDF](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.pdf), [Markdown](https://jp-hardin.github.io/about/mid-market-practice/insights/technology-industry-report-q4-2026.md)): Data center demand is filling order books, consolidators keep paying for recurring revenue, and government contractors are working through a slower award calendar.

## Common questions
- **What does Benchmark International's Middle Market team do?** Benchmark International's Middle Market team represents premier privately held companies across the United States in sell-side M&A, offering white-glove, high-touch service to the firm's largest clients.
- **What size companies does the Middle Market team advise?** Our Middle Market team advises privately held businesses, typically with enterprise values of $50 million to $500 million, that meet applicable M&A broker exemption requirements, including companies with less than $25 million in annual EBITDA or less than $250 million in annual revenue.
- **Which industries does the Middle Market team focus on?** Five industries: Industrials, Business Services, Consumer, Healthcare and Technology.
- **What services does the Middle Market team provide?** Our Middle Market team provides comprehensive sell-side M&A advisory services, specializing in business sales, mergers, controlling ownership transfers, strategic acquisitions, and exit planning for privately held companies. Our services span transaction preparation, valuation analysis, buyer identification, deal structuring, negotiation, and execution, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.
- **Is Benchmark International's Middle Market team registered with FINRA?** No. Benchmark International's Middle Market team is not registered as a FINRA member broker-dealer. The team focuses on qualifying M&A advisory activities conducted in reliance on applicable registration exemptions, including the federal M&A Broker Exemption under Section 15(b)(13) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, where its requirements are satisfied. Our services are subject to the applicable federal and state regulatory requirements governing each engagement and transaction. We do not offer services requiring broker-dealer registration unless conducted through an appropriately registered entity.
- **How does working with Benchmark International start?** The first step is always a confidential conversation about your goals, your company and your options. A senior member of the Middle Market team sets up a private conversation, then walks you through the paths available, from a strategic sale to a merger or change-of-control transaction.
- **How large is Benchmark International?** Headquartered in Tampa, FL, Benchmark International has over 300 employees across 15 global offices in the Americas, Europe and Africa and is proudly ranked the #1 global M&A advisor for privately owned businesses (based on PitchBook's Q2 2026 Global League Tables).
- **How do I contact the Middle Market team?** Call 813-771-6675 or email mmt@benchmarkintl.com.
